description.value: A 35-site BC Parks campground sitting on Summit Lake in the Kootenays, with potable water, a covered shelter, and washrooms — a solid lakeside base. Gate closes seasonally; outside the operating window campers can walk in from the gate but must be fully self-sufficient.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to an official BC Parks page confirming Summit Lake Campground is a real, operating provincial park campground in the Kootenays. However, the fetched content is almost entirely site-wide navigation menus with no park-specific amenity details, and all subpages returned 404 errors. OSM tags (power_supply=no, internet_access=no, sanitary_dump_station=no, capacity=35) provide structural data but per rules cannot be treated as authoritative for amenity claims without website corroboration, so most amenity fields remain null.
concerns: Website fetched only site-wide navigation menus with no park-specific content; all subpages (/about/, /about/news/, etc.) returned 404. Amenity details for Summit Lake Campground could not be verified from the website.
Phone number (+1-866-937-5734) and email (info@westkootenayparks.co) from OSM could not be corroborated by the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating BC Parks campground confirmed by a live official government website; suitable overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags indicate power_supply=no, internet_access=no, and sanitary_dump_station=no, but these could not be confirmed from website content per validation rules and are therefore left as null in amenity fields.
